feeds.title: Meehan Mental Health Services Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about the therapy process and how to get started. I am Ann Meehan of Meehan Mental Health Services. As a therapist I feel passionate about helping children feel confident, secure, and empowered. I specialize in helping children, adolescents, and families heal, grow, and move forward from life's difficulties, big emotions, and challenging behaviors.

feeds.title: Synergetic Play Therapy Institute blog
feeds.description: If you would like to stay informed about upcoming trainings, events and special offers, and receive free resources to inspire and support you along the way, explore the blog. The Synergetic Play Therapy (SPT) community is made up of therapists, parents, teachers and other professionals who embrace connection and relationship, and the opportunity to show up in the world as themselves - genuine, curious, courageous, vulnerable.

feeds.title: Project Play Therapy
feeds.description: Stay up to date with Project Play Therapy with our blog! Project Play strives to empower therapists with diverse training and focus areas to complement our core therapies in order to deliver transcendent services to more children in need. Using activity-based and sensory-driven experiences, our therapists analyze individual sensory profiles and praxis to promote appropriate adaptive responses, manage behavior and encourage social interactions.

feeds.title: Child's Play Therapy Center Blog
feeds.description: The Child'sPlay Therapy Center Blog offers great articles that parents use as a resource to questions they have about there children. We offer speech, occupational, and physical therapies as well as child & family counseling in a non-clinical, child friendly environment!

feeds.title: Wonders Counseling Services Blog
feeds.description: We are providing a variety of resources to support the work of child and family therapists worldwide. Wonders Counseling & Consultation specializes in providing training, support and practice building mentoring for therapists as well as parenting coaching.

feeds.title: Creative Play Therapist
feeds.description: Creative Play Therapist is a blog that shares interventions and resources for child and adolescent therapists.

feeds.title: Brittani Persha Counseling Blog
feeds.description: Child Therapist Blog serving clients in Katy and Houston, TX. Read our blog for tips and tools onissues such as children's anxiety, behavioral problems, family conflict, social skills, ADHD, depression, parenting; and mindfulness. We serve children and families struggling with anxiety, behavior problems, trauma and ADHD. Treatment includes play therapy and parent coaching.

feeds.title: Olympia Therapy Blog
feeds.description: A blog to help support your family toward Mental Wellness. We focus on Play, Connection, Family, & Sensory challenges. Olympia Therapy is Mental Wellness practice for Children, Adults & Families to receive mental health care. We provide in person & Telehealth appointments to meet our clients needs. We specialize in Play Therapy & Child Parent Relationship Training.

feeds.title: Molly and Me Counseling and Training Center Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about our services and therapy, play therapy, benefits and more! Molly and Me Counseling and Training Center is the first play therapy training center in Idaho, established in 2007. An avenue for professionals to learn more about play therapy and enhance their skills, it has also become a place where parents and families can learn more about the power of play.

feeds.title: Jen Taylor Play Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Jen Taylor's blog has play therapy and journal based strategies for optimal mental health, ways to harness your inner wisdom and create joyful relationships and communities. Jen Taylor is a social worker, therapist, teacher and writer. As a therapist, Jen helps people organize traumatic and difficult experiences so that people can experience more joy in their lives and relationships.

feeds.title: Family Systems Hub Blog
feeds.description: Stay informed with the latest information, upcoming events and tips on childhood wellbeing and parenting. Play Therapy Hub houses a co-operative of independent and experienced child play therapists in Melbourne's inner north dedicated to supporting children aged 2-12 to flourish and strengthen families through play based therapeutic interventions.

feeds.title: Play Therapy Connection Blog
feeds.description: Visit our blog for help with ADHD, autism, anxiety & more. Play Therapy Connection offers to counsel to children & individuals in Littleton, CO. Kelly Miller, RPT & Yoga Instructor (RYT-200), creates and teaches unique, online yoga flows to help Play Therapists & Healing professionals discover where the healing principles of therapy and yoga align.

feeds.title: Play Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Play Therapy helps children regulate their behavior, emotions, and learning disorders. Read our blog to get the latest news about Play Therapy and how it can help your child. Play Therapy creates emotionally healthy children with positive long-lasting behavioral change through guidance and support from a trained play therapist and positive use of the therapeutic tools in a safe environment.
